Author: Tiraesias; Enhanced fork: pascalial98-hue
Name: POV+ Enhanced
Description:
看见自己的身体，自由观察、探头，用引导校准到适合自己的视点。
See your body, look around and lean, with guided viewpoint calibration.

新配置默认隐藏头部、保留完整头影，并逐项显示中英对照。已有设置保留；也可选择单语界面和鼠标直控。
New configurations enable head hiding, full head shadows and paired Chinese/English text. Saved settings are retained; single-language UI and direct mouse look are also available.

可选“视角与限位跟随身体姿态”，默认关闭。此选项适合静止姿态观察，不适合移动时使用；即使有平滑处理，跑动时仍可能明显晃动。
Optional body-relative view and limits, off by default. This option is intended for viewing stationary poses, not for use while moving. Running may still cause noticeable camera sway even with smoothing.

面向国服 / Dalamud API 15，国际服尚未验证。
Targets FFXIV CN / Dalamud API 15; international clients are unverified.
Punchline: 沉浸式第一人称增强 / Enhanced first-person camera (CN)
Changelog:
1.6.1.4：新增默认关闭的身体姿态视角与限位，抬头上限可设为 90°，加入移动旋转平滑。
Add default-off body-relative view and limits, allow looking up 90°, and smooth animation rotation while moving.

此选项适合静止姿态观察，不适合移动时使用；即使有平滑处理，跑动时仍可能明显晃动。
This option is intended for viewing stationary poses, not for use while moving. Running may still cause noticeable camera sway even with smoothing.

已有用户直接更新，原库链接及设置保留。
